name: discovery-bench-simplified
description: A simplified version of a discovery/retrieval benchmark designed to evaluate retrieval-augmented models on discovery and open-ended question answering tasks. Measures models' ability to find relevant documents and produce accurate, concise answers using retrieved evidence.
evaluation_method: retrieval metrics (nDCG / MRR) and answer quality metrics (F1 / exact match or human_eval for final answers)
general_score_metric: nDCG for retrieval / F1 or exact_match for answer quality
reputation: Lightweight and practical for quick experiments; used by researchers exploring retrieval-augmented generation but not a dominant community standard.
